scenes.spoken_text: A table is a system of top, base and connections. Trace load paths, coordinate material interfaces and identify the evidence needed to review stability and performance.
scenes.caption: A table is a system of top, base and connections. Trace load paths, coordinate material interfaces and identify the evidence needed to review stability and performance.

scenes.display_title: Define the top and support relationship
scenes.spoken_text: Record the top material, build-up, grain direction where relevant, edges, use and cleaning needs. A fixing detail cannot simply transfer between solid timber, faced board and stone. A section should identify top, support, connection and unsupported projection. An apparent thick edge may be an applied detail; appearance does not establish structural thickness.
scenes.caption: Identify the actual build-up before selecting the interface.

scenes.spoken_text: Trace load from top through frame or pedestal to floor contacts. A central base changes edge projections, while perimeter legs affect seating. A load-path sketch is not proof of adequacy. Define expected loading, edge use, sway, twisting and floor conditions for an appropriate technical review; do not improvise testing by standing on the table or adding arbitrary loads.
scenes.caption: The load path defines the review; it does not certify capacity.

scenes.spoken_text: Identify permanent/removable connections, tool access and material movement the system must accommodate. Solid timber dimensions can change with humidity; do not assume rigid restraint in every direction. Obtain a suitable manufacturer/specialist detail. In an exercise with a 1600 mm top and centered 1000 mm base length, each end projects (1600 − 1000) ÷ 2 = 300 mm; this does not validate the projection structurally.
scenes.caption: 300 mm is geometric projection, not a capacity approval.

scenes.spoken_text: The solid-timber top on a metal base has a 300 mm exercise projection at each end, but the drawing specifies rigid attachment without explaining movement accommodation. Return the interface for review and require the connection, movement and tool-access detail before manufacture. Decision: complete the movement/connection detail and performance review.
scenes.caption: Decision: complete the movement/connection detail and performance review.
